general_background.title: A sulfur donor whose reactivity depends on the liquid
general_background.summary: Thioacetamide can produce sulfide species during heated solution growth, rather than supplying the full reactive sulfide dose immediately. Its conversion can therefore affect the competition between separate nucleation and growth at existing surfaces.

general_background.title: Urea can provide gradual basification
general_background.summary: Under aqueous heating, urea can generate basic species as it decomposes. Gradual basification changes the buildup of supersaturation, which can affect how uniformly a metal hydroxide or oxide precursor precipitates.
general_background.label: General background, not the authors' interpretation
